summary.text: Brian Seaworth is a Republican state representative from Merrimack District 12 who has served since December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary. Ballotpedia lists his career experience as engineer and software founder.

paragraphs.text: Seaworth earned a B.S. in mechanical engineering from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute in 1988, according to Ballotpedia.

His career experience includes working as an engineer at American Electric Power, McDonnell Douglas Aerospace and Gensym, and as a consultant for Rohn Rogers Associates, and he founded the software platform Financial Robotics.

Ballotpedia lists Seaworth on the Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee in legislative sessions dating back to 2011-2012, including as clerk in 2015 and as vice chair in 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
